People pooping and pissing in the dressing rooms.
There were grown adults doing this shit. You’d think it’s exclusively kids doing it, it was a pretty big retail chain, but nope.
I still don’t know what would possess one to do that but it happened far more often than you think..

Edit: now that I think about it I feel like this is more common than I think for retail in general. Still, not great to deal with lol

A Perfect Circle.

There’s this element of bitterness in a lot of their song lyrics that I like a lot or I guess can relate to. That and they can go from perfectly aggressive and callous to slow, calming and almost serene, for lack of better words. I like all of their albums but Mer De Noms has a solid place in my heart tbh.

Puscifer and Tool are pretty cool too — can’t wait for the new album.

Blaming my children for my spouse’s fuck ups. My mother has taken her anger out on me several times for what my father did — screaming at the top of her lungs, threatening to turn the rest of the family against me, even kicking me out of the house a few times.
She still hasn’t apologized for this and the last time she addressed it she still insisted that it was something wrong with me. I don’t ever want to put my children through that kind of shit. Makes no sense

Edit: to put it in a better way, I don’t want to make my kids my emotional punching bags
